text: Which genes specific to liver hepatocellular carcinoma among cancers are markers of shorter survival in it, potential or validated, liver-specific, hepatocyte-specific in the single-cell data, and are not secreted into the blood?
plan: Cancer category (RNA): Liver Hepatocellular Carcinoma / Cancer enriched AND Prognostic cancer: Liver Hepatocellular Carcinoma / Unfavorable - potential prognostic, Unfavorable - validated prognostic AND Tissue category (RNA): Liver / Tissue enriched AND Cell type category (scRNA): Hepatocytes / Cell type enriched AND NOT Secretome annotation: Secreted to blood
understanding: The question asks for genes that are specific to liver hepatocellular carcinoma (among cancers), associated with shorter patient survival in liver hepatocellular carcinoma (unfavourable prognosis), liver-specific in normal tissue RNA expression, hepatocyte-specific in single-cell RNA-seq data, and excluded from being secreted into the blood.

trail.requirement: specific to liver hepatocellular carcinoma among cancers
trail.why: To identify genes specific to liver hepatocellular carcinoma among cancers, Liver Hepatocellular Carcinoma is selected at level 1 with the 'Cancer enriched' category, defined as having at least four-fold higher mRNA expression compared to any other cancer type.

trail.requirement: markers of shorter survival in it, potential or validated
trail.why: The requirement specifies potential or validated markers of shorter survival (unfavorable prognosis) in liver hepatocellular carcinoma.
To identify liver-specific genes, the tissue is restricted to liver and the category to 'Tissue enriched', which requires at least four-fold higher expression compared to any other tissue.

The requirement calls for genes that are hepatocyte-specific in the single-cell data, which corresponds to selecting 'Hepatocytes' at Level 1 and 'Cell type enriched' (defined as at least four-fold higher mRNA level compared to any other cell type) at Level 2.
Selecting 'Secreted to blood' identifies the proteins secreted into the blood to be excluded.

requirements.requirement: specific to liver hepatocellular carcinoma among cancers
requirements.why: This field defines RNA specificity across TCGA cancer cohorts, including Liver Hepatocellular Carcinoma.

requirements.requirement: markers of shorter survival in it, potential or validated
requirements.why: This field defines associations between gene expression and patient survival (prognosis) in specific TCGA cohorts such as Liver Hepatocellular Carcinoma.
This field assesses RNA specificity and distribution across human tissues, with liver available as an option.
This field captures RNA specificity across single-cell types, including Hepatocytes.
This field annotates predicted secreted proteins by destination, including 'Secreted to blood', which is excluded using NOT.
